title: The Lantern Keeper
synopsis: On a lonely island, a girl keeps the last lighthouse burning. One stormy night a stranger's boat is lost at sea, and only her lantern can bring it home.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: At the edge of the world stood a small island, and on the island stood a lighthouse. Every evening, a girl named Ife climbed its stairs and lit the great lamp.

scenes.speaker: ife
scenes.text: Tonight the sky looks angry. I had better keep the lamp burning until morning.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The storm arrived without warning. Waves rose like walls, and far out on the water a tiny boat was thrown from side to side.

scenes.speaker: kunle
scenes.text: I cannot see the rocks! Is anyone out there? Show me the way!

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The boat reached the cove safely. Kunle jumped onto the sand and cheered with joy.
